## The Independent Student Bodies (ISB) at IIT Madras are non-governing, student-run organizations independent of the central Executive Student Body (Sac/Gymkhana). They span various focus areas, including cultural/linguistic heritage, social activism, wellness, and spiritual/faith-based communities.
